Hotel Group Clarifies Fee Policy
By Daniel Ferreira
(3 March) — Many travelers find it difficult to understand the extra charges that appear on their hotel bills. Since last spring, a number of hotels in Lisbon have been adding an optional contribution of 2 euros per night to guests' bills to support the cleaning of the city's beaches. However, several guests, assuming the contribution was mandatory, submitted complaints to the Lisbon Tourism Office in January.
On Monday, the Lisbon Hotel Owners' Network (LHON) released a statement explaining that the contribution is entirely voluntary. "Frankly, I did not expect so many people to object," said LHON chair Inês Carvalho. "Guests have always been free to ask that the amount be removed from their bills before they pay."
LHON plans to provide training sessions so that front-desk employees can explain the contribution clearly to guests at check-in.

월요일에 리스본 호텔 소유주 네트워크(LHON)는 이 기부금이 전적으로 자발적이라고 설명하는 성명을 발표했다. LHON 회장 이네스 카르발류는 "솔직히 이렇게 많은 사람이 반대할 줄은 몰랐다"며 "투숙객은 언제나 결제 전에 청구서에서 그 금액을 빼 달라고 요청할 수 있었다"고 말했다.

Delivery Group Addresses Customer Concerns
By Wei Ling Tan
(22 September) — Online food ordering has grown rapidly, but not every part of the process is clear to users. Several delivery apps in Singapore now automatically add a recommended tip of 1 to 3 dollars for couriers to each order. In July, a group of customers, thinking that the tip could not be removed, lodged a formal complaint with the Consumers Association of Singapore.
Yesterday, the Singapore Delivery Platforms Alliance (SDPA) announced that the tip is completely voluntary. "The complaint caught me off guard," said SDPA director Kevin Lim. "Users have always been able to change the amount or set it to zero before they pay."
The SDPA is now asking its member companies to add a clear message about the tip to the payment screen of their apps.

Port Halden at 50: A Town Transformed
When Port Halden was incorporated fifty years ago, nearly all of its residents depended on the fishing industry for their income. ― [1] ―. By the time the town marked its twenty-fifth anniversary, however, the fishing industry could no longer provide enough jobs for the town's expanding population.
It was then that local leaders recognized the need for major change, and the Halden Forward plan was introduced. ― [2] ―. The plan aimed to bring a variety of industries to Port Halden so that, by its fiftieth anniversary, the town would no longer rely on a single source of employment.
"Our first step was to build a skilled workforce," explained current Mayor Sofia Lindqvist. "The town opened a new technical college and expanded its hospital. ― [3] ―. We also launched an advertising campaign to persuade companies to move here."
Today, as Port Halden celebrates its fiftieth anniversary, it is home to software developers, a medical equipment manufacturer, and several popular hotels. ― [4] ―. "Halden Forward has achieved everything we hoped for," said Mayor Lindqvist.

포트 홀든이 50년 전 시로 승격되었을 때, 거의 모든 주민이 어업에 소득을 의존했다. ― [1] ―. 그러나 도시가 25주년을 맞을 무렵, 어업은 늘어나는 도시 인구에게 더 이상 충분한 일자리를 제공할 수 없었다.

Questions 158-160 refer to the following article.

Greenvale at 75: Celebrating a New Era
When Greenvale was founded seventy-five years ago, coal mining was the main source of jobs for its residents. ― [1] ―. By the time the city celebrated its fortieth anniversary, however, several mines had closed, and many workers were struggling to find employment.
At that point, city leaders realized that bold action was required, and the Greenvale 75 initiative was created. ― [2] ―. Its aim was to attract new kinds of businesses so that, by the city's seventy-fifth anniversary, Greenvale's economy would rest on many industries rather than one.
"We knew companies would come only if we offered them talented employees and modern infrastructure," said current Mayor Daniel Okafor. "So we funded job-training programs and installed high-speed Internet throughout the city. ― [3] ―. We also promoted Greenvale aggressively at business fairs across the country."
This year, as Greenvale reaches its seventy-fifth anniversary, the city hosts companies in a wide range of fields, including SunCrest Solar, Peakview Resorts, and Norland Data Services. ― [4] ―. "Greenvale 75 has clearly paid off," said Mayor Okafor.
sets.tr:
158-160번은 다음 기사에 관한 문제입니다.

75주년을 맞은 그린베일: 새 시대를 기념하다
그린베일이 75년 전 세워졌을 때, 석탄 채굴이 주민들의 주된 일자리였다. ― [1] ―. 그러나 시가 40주년을 기념할 무렵, 여러 광산이 문을 닫았고 많은 노동자가 일자리를 찾는 데 어려움을 겪고 있었다.
그 시점에 시 지도자들은 과감한 조치가 필요하다는 것을 깨달았고, '그린베일 75' 계획이 만들어졌다. ― [2] ―. 그 목표는 새로운 종류의 기업을 끌어들여, 시의 75주년이 될 때쯤에는 그린베일의 경제가 하나가 아닌 여러 산업에 기반하도록 하는 것이었다.
현 시장 대니얼 오카포는 "우리는 유능한 직원과 현대적인 기반 시설을 제공해야만 기업들이 올 것이라는 것을 알았다"며 "그래서 직업 훈련 프로그램에 자금을 대고 시 전역에 초고속 인터넷을 설치했다. ― [3] ―. 또한 전국의 비즈니스 박람회에서 그린베일을 적극적으로 홍보했다"고 말했다.
올해 75주년을 맞은 그린베일에는 선크레스트 솔라, 피크뷰 리조트, 노랜드 데이터 서비스를 포함해 폭넓은 분야의 기업들이 자리하고 있다. ― [4] ―. 오카포 시장은 "그린베일 75는 분명히 성과를 거두었다"고 말했다.

[삽입 문장] 이 기업들은 모두 합쳐 6,000명이 넘는 지역 주민을 고용하고 있다.
